name: starfleet-panel
description: An LCARS status panel under the Claude Code prompt, in the style of a 24th-century Starfleet console; follows red-alert's alert condition.

layout.title: Panel layout
layout.description: bridge: the three-row LCARS ops console; compact: one row; off: only Claude Code's own hint line.

labels.title: Terminology
labels.description: starfleet: HELM, CORE, DILITHIUM, stardate, CONDITION…; plain: MODEL, CONTEXT, 5H LIMIT, date, ALERTS…. /lcars plain and /lcars starfleet switch it too.

showCost.title: Show session cost
showCost.description: Add the ENERGY column (the session's cost) on wide terminals.

showUserHost.title: Show user@host
showUserHost.description: Add the CREW column (user@host) on wide terminals.

followRedAlert.title: Follow red-alert
followRedAlert.description: Show red-alert's alert condition, and repaint the panel in the alert's color while red-alert shows an alert.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the panel re-reads the context window and rate limits.
